def test_summarize_basic():
    jobs = [
        {"status": "new"},
        {"status": "applied"},
        {"status": "rejected"},
        {"status": "other_status"},
    ]
    expected = {"new": 1, "applied": 1, "rejected": 1, "other": 1}
    assert summarize(jobs) == expected

def test_summarize_case_and_spaces():
    jobs = [
        {"status": " NEW "},
        {"status": "Applied"},
        {"status": "REJECTED"},
        {"status": "unknown"},
    ]
    expected = {"new": 1, "applied": 1, "rejected": 1, "other": 1}
    assert summarize(jobs) == expected

    jobs = [
        {"status": "new"},
        {"status": None},
        {"status": "applied"},
        {},  # Missing status key
        {"status": "unknown"},
        {"status": "something_weird"},
    ]
    # new: 1

    # rejected: 0

    # This could mean:
    # if status in ['new', 'applied', 'rejected']: count in that key
    # else: count in 'other'
    
    expected = {"new": 1, "applied": 1, "rejected": 0, "other": 3}
    assert summarize(jobs) == expected

    jobs = []
    expected = {"new": 0, "applied": 0, "rejected": 0, "other": 0}
    assert summarize(jobs) == expected
